agenda_text:
City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
December 20, 2010
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
Presentation to Sister City Exchange students.
Presentation of city plaque to former Planning Commissioner Dave Popelka.
Presentation of Layoff Diversion Program by Lomita Chamber of Commerce.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes - December 6, 2010
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Second reading and adoption of Ordinance No. 735 amending Chapter 4 of Title III - Animals by making modifications to the Department of Animal Care and Control animal license enforcement fees and delinquency charges. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
e.
Report recommending distribution of funds from 2010 Golf Tournament and approval of April 22 date for 2011 Golf Tournament. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
f.
Report recommending approval of a resolution authorizing investments with First Empire Securities and designating city officials authorized to deposit or withdraw monies therein. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
g.
Report recommending approval of resolution authorizing investments in the Local Agency Investment Fund and designating city officials authorized to deposit or withdraw monies therein. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
ADOPTION OF COUNTY CODES Public Hearing adopting urgency ordinance and introducing for first reading the ordinance amending Sections 10-1, 10-2, 10-3, 10-4, and adding Section 10-7 (Residential Code) of the Lomita Municipal Code, relative to the adoption by reference the 2011 Los Angeles County Building, Electrical, Plumbing, Mechanical, and Residential Codes with certain amendments necessitated by local conditions and to make the new regulations effective immediately upon adoption and apply to any application for permits made after January 1, 2011.
Presented by Assistant City Manager Gary Sugano.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
SPEED LIMIT SIGNS ON 240TH STREET Consideration of installation of speed limit signs on 240th Street between Eshelman Avenue and Narbonne Avenue.
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron.
8.
CITY COUNCIL ASSIGNMENTS Designation of Councilmember assignments to various organizations.
Presented by City Manager Tomita.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
